How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Nagaland University Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 29-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Nagaland University Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 29 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the university before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Com/MBA in Finance with expertise in specific areas like Project Management and Operation Management, along with practical teaching or industry experience. A Ph.D./NET with published research papers is also required.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Assistant Professor post on a contract basis at Nagaland University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be offered a salary as per Academic Pay Level 10 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the designated address provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Professor post will primarily involve an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Nagaland University located?
faq.answer: Nagaland University is located in Medziphema, Nagaland, with the pincode 797106.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based recruitment for the Assistant Professor position.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with industry experience apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with practical industry experience, along with the required educational qualifications and proof, are encouraged to apply.
